Kreis 4 — Zurich, Switzerland

In detail

Kreis 4 is one of the 12 official Stadtkreise the city of Zurich is divided into, covering Werd, Langstrasse, Hard. Kantonspolizei Zürich recorded 7,884 offences under the Swiss Criminal Code here in 2025 across 28,437 residents — 277.2 per 1,000, 273% of the citywide average of 101.6. The figure is the canton's own published Häufigkeitszahl, normalised against registered residents rather than the people who pass through, so a central Kreis with few residents and heavy daily footfall reads higher than the experience of being there would suggest. Zurich publishes no crime statistic below Stadtkreis level, and the same figure therefore applies to every Quartier inside this one. It is an annual snapshot, not a live feed, and it carries no time of day: the day and night levels shown here come from the same number.

Frequently asked questions

Is Kreis 4 safe?

Wandroz currently rates Kreis 4 in Zurich as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Zurich. This rating is derived from Kantonspolizei Zürich's official Polizeiliche Kriminalstatistik, by Stadtkreis — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats. The source data has no day/night breakdown, so this single rating applies at any time of day rather than being a distinct night-specific figure.

Does Kreis 4's rating differ between day and night?

No — Kreis 4's source data has no time-of-day breakdown, so the same rating (an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Zurich) is shown for both day and night rather than Wandroz inventing a separate night figure it doesn't actually have.

Is Kreis 4 a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Kreis 4's day rating (an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Zurich) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
